services:

    command:
      - mysqld
      - --innodb-buffer-pool-size=134217728

      MYSQL_DATABASE: lab
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: disposable-lab-only
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - MYSQL_PWD=$$MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD mysql --protocol=TCP -h127.0.0.1 -uroot --database=lab
          --execute="SELECT 1" --silent
      timeout: 5s
      interval: 2s
      retries: 90
    image: public.ecr.aws/docker/library/mysql@sha256:6ea90827b1100f8f2ae306a539f86d2c264a26ed435a2a9f75551dd5c3aeb242
    networks:
      default: null
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: mysql-data
        target: /var/lib/mysql
        volume: {}
  pg:
    command:
      - postgres
      - -c
      - shared_buffers=128MB
      - -c
      - max_parallel_workers_per_gather=0
      - -c
      - jit=off
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: lab
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: disposable-lab-only
      POSTGRES_USER: lab
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U lab -d lab
      timeout: 5s
      interval: 2s
      retries: 90
    image: public.ecr.aws/docker/library/postgres@sha256:d74eeac9a635390a49bc21bd49fccd973de707e2a53a76ac49b552b8712ec46f
    networks:
      default: null
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: pg-data
        target: /var/lib/postgresql/data
        volume: {}
